brush.page_text: Flexible bristles glide through wet or dry hair without pulling.
brush.behaviour: Its flexible bristles bend and part the hair as it is pulled down from root to tip.
brush.person: A woman in her twenties with long wavy brown hair, in a bright bathroom.
lines: Meet the Glide Detangling Brush from Tessa Hair, made for knots on wet or dry hair.
Its flexible bristles glide through wet or dry hair without pulling, every single morning.
Get your Glide Detangling Brush today for just $18.00 from Tessa Hair, and feel the difference.
shows: the presenter shows the brush to the lens
the brush glides down through long wet hair
the presenter brushes her hair

cream.page_text: A light whipped cream that melts into skin and leaves no shine.
cream.colour: white jar with a gold lid
cream.behaviour: The thick white cream thins and disappears into the skin as it is rubbed in.
cream.person: A woman in her thirties with clear skin, in a calm white bathroom.
lines: Meet Cloud Whip Face Cream from Lumen Skin, the light cream for soft skin every day.
This light whipped cream melts into your skin and leaves no shine at all, morning or night.
Get your Cloud Whip Face Cream today for just $32.00 from Lumen Skin, and feel the difference.
shows: the presenter holds up the jar
fingers rub a dab of cream into a cheek until it disappears
the presenter pats her face

floss.page_text: A soft mint floss that slides between tight teeth without shredding.
floss.real_size: small round case, about 5 cm wide
floss.behaviour: The thin floss bends around each tooth and slides down between tight teeth.
floss.person: A man in his twenties with a bright smile, at a bathroom mirror.
lines: Meet Mint Ribbon Floss from Brightbite, the soft floss for a fresh clean smile.
It slides between tight teeth without shredding, so flossing feels quick and easy every night.
Get your Mint Ribbon Floss today for just $6.00 from Brightbite, and feel the difference.
shows: the presenter shows the floss case to the lens
a length of floss slides down between two front teeth
the presenter smiles at the mirror

bottle.page_text: A steel bottle with a flip handle that keeps water cold for 24 hours.
bottle.behaviour: The flip handle swings up from the lid and stops upright, so the bottle hangs from one finger.
bottle.person: A woman in her thirties in hiking clothes, at a sunny trailhead.
lines: Meet the Trailmate Bottle from Northpeak, the steel bottle made for long days outside.
Flip up the handle and carry it on one finger, and your water stays cold for 24 hours.
Get your Trailmate Bottle today for just $28.00 from Northpeak, and feel the difference.
shows: the presenter shows the bottle to the lens
a finger flips the handle up and lifts the bottle
the presenter drinks from the bottle

roller.page_text: A cool jade roller that glides over skin to calm puffiness.
roller.colour: pale green stone on a gold frame
roller.behaviour: The stone barrel turns on its frame as the roller is pushed over the skin.
roller.person: A woman in her twenties with a towel in her hair, at a vanity.
lines: Meet the Chill Stone Face Roller from Velia, a cool calm start to every morning.
The cool jade roller glides over your skin to calm puffiness in just a few minutes.
Get your Chill Stone Face Roller today for just $24.00 from Velia, and feel the difference.
shows: the presenter shows the roller to the lens
the roller glides up a cheek
the presenter rolls her jaw

lens.page_text: A clip-on macro lens that turns any phone into a close-up camera.
lens.behaviour: The clip opens, grips the phone's corner over the camera and holds still.
lens.person: A man in his twenties with a camera bag, in a plant-filled studio.
lines: Meet the Orbit Lens Clip from Snapkit, the easy way to shoot close-ups on your phone.
Clip it on and any phone becomes a close-up camera for flowers, food and tiny details.
Get your Orbit Lens Clip today for just $22.00 from Snapkit, and feel the difference.
shows: the presenter shows the clip to the lens
the clip snaps onto a phone's corner over its camera
the presenter shoots a flower close up

speaker.page_text: A palm-sized speaker with a rubber base that sits steady on any table.
speaker.behaviour: It lands flat on its rubber base and stays put without rolling.
speaker.person: A woman in her twenties, in a cosy living room.
lines: Meet the Pebble Speaker from Hush Audio, a palm-sized speaker with big clear sound.
Its rubber base sits steady on any table, so the music plays on wherever you set it down.
Get your Pebble Speaker today for just $45.00 from Hush Audio, and feel the difference.
shows: the presenter shows the speaker to the lens
the speaker is set down onto a wooden table
the presenter taps play and smiles

vacuum.page_text: A cordless hand vacuum that lifts crumbs from tables and car seats in seconds.
vacuum.behaviour: Crumbs are sucked up into the nozzle and the surface behind it is left clean.
vacuum.person: A man in his thirties, in a bright kitchen.
lines: Meet the Crumb Hand Vacuum from Tidyhome, the quick fix for crumbs all over the house.
It lifts crumbs from tables and car seats in seconds, and it runs without a cord.
Get your Crumb Hand Vacuum today for just $39.00 from Tidyhome, and feel the difference.
shows: the presenter shows the vacuum to the lens
the vacuum passes over crumbs on a table and leaves it clean
the presenter puts the vacuum on its stand
